summary.elkies_counting_constant_k: Not explicitly stated in any of the three abstracts. The ~1/2 fraction of Elkies primes for a generic curve is a standard result from SEA (Schoof-Elkies-Atkin) theory; would be cited in Schoof's original work or Elkies 1990 / Sutherland point-counting papers, not in these three references.
